title: Governed runtime patch dependency refresh replacing Dependabot PR #174
description: Rebuild the governed production runtime patch set from Dependabot PR #174 on the canonical baseline after PR #205 completed. Preserve the canonical development dependency refresh while applying only the five runtime updates. Only package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, this Task Contract and generated Task Catalog may change.

baseline_equivalence.reason: PR #205 intentionally changed development dependency manifests and lockfile before this serialized rebuild.
baseline_equivalence.preservation_rule: Preserve all canonical PR #205 development dependency versions while applying only the five runtime updates from source Dependabot PR #174.

acceptance_criteria.description: The replacement reproduces only the five production runtime patch updates from Dependabot PR #174 on the post-#205 canonical main while preserving the canonical development dependency refresh.

pnpm-lock.yaml composes the five runtime updates with the already-canonical #205 development dependency state; frozen install, lockfile supply-chain policy and full verification must prove the combined lockfile rather than reusing the stale pre-#205 lockfile.
Canonical CI and Phase A pass on the exact replacement head, including full pnpm verify, Storefront verification, backend build and regression tests.
No runtime source, API, database, migration, workflow, deployment, Roadmap, current-state or product-design file changes enter this task.
HIGH-risk dependency transport requires exact-artifact REVIEW, SECURITY, HUMAN and LOCK evidence plus required status checks before protected merge. This task itself does not authorize merge.

external_gate_evidence.rule: HIGH-risk production dependency refresh. Human approval on the exact artifact is mandatory. No automatic merge.
